subject: Renewal: hosted API commit uptier, tier refactor & soft overage bridge
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightgrid.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@brightgrid.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — hosted API commit uplift & tier changes

Hi Laura,

We’re getting close to our renewal (end of June) and our usage has outpaced the current commit. Quarter-to-date token consumption is ~35% higher than expected due to a new personalization pipeline. We’re evaluating a stepped monthly commit increase plus a rework of rate tiers to avoid repeated overages.

High level ask: can Redwood put together a proposal for a staged monthly commit increase (three-month ramp), a revised usage tier map (to smooth per-token rates at scale), and a soft overage bridge for the first 60 days after go-live so we don’t see surprise invoices? Our procurement team also asked for an annual prepay option with an associated discount to simplify forecasting.

Key constraints:
- Want predictable costs during ramp (no >25% month-over-month invoice delta)
- Need the option to burst beyond commit during marketing peak windows
- Procurement prefers a one-page amendment and DocuSign flow

If you can draft a MATP (mutual action + pricing) and a one-pager amendment, that would help speed internal approvals on our side. Can we get a kickoff call this week? I’m available Thursday morning PT.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightGrid Inc.

Attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@brightgrid.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API commit uplift & tier changes

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear rundown. Thu morning PT works; I’ll send a calendar invite for 10:00am PT and include a short draft MATP and pricing sketch.

Preliminary thoughts before the call:
- Staged ramp: suggest +30% month 1, +20% month 2, then commit to new monthly baseline in month 3 (we can tweak based on your traffic profile).
- Rate tiers: we’ll propose a 3-band revision that reduces per-token cost above 1.5x current commit and offers a burst pocket for transient spikes.
- Soft overage bridge: 60-day protection where overages are capped at 10% of the new baseline and invoiced at a reduced overage rate; overages beyond burst pocket handled per standard terms.
- Annual prepay: we can offer a 7% credit on token spend if BrightGrid prepays 12 months of the new baseline.

I attached a one-page MATP draft and a CSV price sketch to this reply — it’s a working draft so we can iterate during the call. I’ve looped in Vanessa (CS lead) and Karthik (pricing/finance) to make sure the proposed lanes and invoice cadence are feasible.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: BrightGrid_MATP_draft_v1.pdf; pricing-summary-uptier.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — hosted API commit uplift & tier changes

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Daniel’s note and my draft MATP/pricing sketch. Need quick alignment on two operational points before the call:

1) Burst pocket sizing: propose reserving a 20% monthly burst bucket with automated gating. If BrightGrid needs >20% sustained for more than 10 days, we transition them to the staged ramp. Does that match realistic ops constraints?
2) Invoice cadence / overage treatment: we proposed a capped 10% overage at a reduced rate for 60 days. Finance needs the final per-token overage price to model cashflow. If we do annual prepay with a 7% credit, finance wants to confirm revenue recognition timing and whether we can offer a one-time onboarding credit.

Call is 2027-05-27T17:00:00Z (10:00am PT) — please review the attached pricing CSV and flag anything that will block negotiation.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — hosted API commit uplift & tier changes

Laura / Karthik — quick replies inline.

On burst pocket sizing:
- Ops: 20% monthly burst with automated gating is reasonable. We’ll implement prefix-based throttles and a temporary burst pool; paging threshold remains the same. Recommend a soft warning at 80% of burst to avoid surprises.

On overage treatment and annual prepay:
- Pricing: Finance suggests the reduced overage rate be set at 60% of the standard overage price for the 60-day bridge (we can surface exact cents in the CSV).
- Annual prepay: 7% credit is OK if BrightGrid commits to a 12-month baseline equal to the month-3 new commit. No additional onboarding credit without exec sign-off.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices with a one-time prorated invoice for the month the new baseline takes effect (we’ll include burst usage details in the line items).

I’ll prepare a signature-ready amendment PDF (amendment-signature-ready.pdf) and a DocuSign envelope. If Karthik approves final unit prices I’ll attach the DocuSign link to the email to the customer post-call.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

All — reviewed the pricing CSV. Finalized positions:

- New baseline (month 3) = 1.4x current monthly commit (matches projected TP90).
- Month 1 = +30%; Month 2 = +15%; Month 3 baseline = +40% (we’ll map exact token counts in the HubSpot record).
- Overage bridge rate = 0.6x standard overage price for 60 days; cap at 10% of baseline for bridge period.
- Annual prepay: 7% credit on invoiced spend; revenue recognition flows per standard contract accounting — no extra credits.

I approve pushing the amendment to DocuSign once Vanessa attaches signature-ready PDF. Please confirm and I’ll update HubSpot with the deal stage and the forecast.

-karthik

Hi Daniel / Emily — great call today. Thanks for walking through the traffic pattern and peak windows. Attached is the finalized one-page amendment and the pricing summary; DocuSign envelope created here: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/BG-2027-041.

What we’ve agreed:
- Staged ramp: +30% (month 1), +15% (month 2), new baseline at +40% in month 3 (baseline expressed as tokens/month in the amendment).
- Burst pocket: 20% monthly, with automated gating and alerts at 80% of burst consumption.
- Overage bridge: 60 days at 60% of standard overage rate, capped at 10% of new baseline.
- Annual prepay: optional; 7% credit if BrightGrid prepays the month-3 baseline for 12 months.
- Invoice cadence: monthly; one-time prorated invoice at baseline switch.

Next steps for BrightGrid:
1) Review amendment and countersign via DocuSign: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/BG-2027-041
2) If you choose annual prepay, indicate on the DocuSign form and we’ll return a final invoice for signature.
